Nina CSM: FYI - PulseCare QBR this Thu 9am PT. Need a short section on token econ + onboarding status. Dropping the quick facts here, please flag anything we should call out.

Carlos FinOps: Quick spend snapshot to include on the slide:
```
Estimated monthly tokens: 1,120,000
Rate (avg): $2.10 / 1k tokens
Projected spend: ~$2,352/month
Month-over-month: +28% (driven by nightly sync + long-chat sessions)
Anomaly: spike on 2025-04-02 aligned with model experiments
```

Jia CS: Onboarding progress: core integration done, docs ingestion pipeline at 70%. Remaining: schema mapping for CHR fields + customer-requested prompt examples. Renewal sentiment: cautious positive if we can reduce cost friction.

Marco Support: We logged a rate-limit cascade (429) during the spike window. Root cause looks like a single job retry loop. I can add jitter/backoff and cap concurrency.

Priya Enable: I can run a 20-min hands-on session focused on prompt templates that save tokens and on quick eval heuristics. Available Wed 3pm PT. Will prepare two before/after prompt examples.

Carlos FinOps: For the QBR slide, recommend we call out: (1) nightly re-ingestion as a cost hotspot, (2) long-chat customer flows. Propose mitigation options: scheduling off-peak, lightweight model variant for batch jobs, and caching of embeddings.

Nina CSM: Deployment: hosted environment with one dedicated endpoint for PHI. Heavy route: nightly docs re-ingest (~200k docs) and interactive clinician chat with long context windows.

Jia CS: Suggest trialing an 8-bit quantized model for the batch re-ingest first. Expect ~20% cost savings; will run a 12-hour sample and report tokens/sec and latency.

Marco Support: I'll patch the ingestion job to split into 10k doc chunks and add backoff. Staging deploy tonight, prod roll tomorrow early AM if tests pass.

Carlos FinOps: If Jia's sample confirms savings, I'll produce a before/after spend projection for the deck. Need sample run metrics by EOD tomorrow.

Jia CS: ETA for sample numbers: tomorrow 6pm PT.

Priya Enable: Enabling slides + invite shared. Will include a quick checklist for PulseCare to adopt token-saving patterns post-QBR.

AlertBot: Billing alert: "PulseCare usage exceeded baseline by 34% on 2025-04-02" - ticket #BILL-9477 created.

Nina CSM: Action items: 1) Jia: run quant sample (ETA: tomorrow 6pm PT) 2) Marco: patch ingestion job + staging test (ETA: staging tonight, prod AM) 3) Carlos: cost projection for QBR (ETA: tomorrow 4pm PT) 4) Priya: enablement session Wed 3pm PT (slides + examples) 5) Nina: consolidate QBR deck and finalize risk/mitigation slide. Add ETAs in replies.

Carlos FinOps: Cost deck ETA: tomorrow 4pm PT.

Marco Support: Staging tests scheduled tonight. Prod tentative 7:30am PT tomorrow.

Jia CS: Will post metrics by 6pm PT tomorrow.

Priya Enable: Confirmed invite and slide deck uploaded.

Nina CSM: Thanks all - I'll assemble the deck once metrics land. Please ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
